notes: All 20 tasks, 3 runs per side, run order sanity (5 tasks) -> full run -> 3 runs. Judge: claude-opus-4-6 on both sides. No-experiments setting. Run-score ranges overlap (original 0.192-0.310, Harbor 0.261-0.339); MSE of per-task mean rewards 0.0246; 7/20 tasks identical. Endpoints: the first 71 audits (35 original, 36 Harbor) went through 2077AI's PP API gateway; when it stopped answering, the remaining 49 (25 original, 24 Harbor) went through OpenRouter (anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5, judge anthropic/claude-opus-4.6). Requests used the alias claude-haiku-4-5, which both gateways serve as claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, the only Haiku 4.5 snapshot (the PP API does not accept the dated ID). Infrastructure failures, each rerun once and the rerun kept whatever its score: Harbor lazy-alpha AgentTimeoutError (slow gateway; the agent timeout was then raised to 4 h, upstream has none), Daytona SandboxBuildFailedError on hidden-green (1) and hop-jump (4, storage error), multi-pen connection reset during setup; original multi_gem and multi_pen epoch 2 cancelled by a host restart; trials cancelled while the PP API hung. Harbor has no epochs: run i is each task's i-th finished trial.
